# Fluidweb

> Fluidweb is the freelance studio of Wissile Sogoyou, a software engineer based in Salt Lake City, Utah. It designs and builds websites and mobile apps for individuals, small businesses and startups, with SEO, AEO and GEO built in. Every project is priced block by block and the full price list is public.

## Services

- Website design and development: from $1,450.
- SEO, AEO and GEO optimization: priced per page or as one-time blocks, added to a website build.
- Mobile app design and development for iOS and Android: from $3,800.

## How pricing works

- Every project is a foundation, plus a price per page or screen, plus optional blocks. Each block has a fixed listed price. There are 110 blocks.
- Website: $1,200 foundation plus $250 per page (1 to 50 pages). The foundation includes: discovery call and project plan; responsive, mobile-first build; hosting setup and launch; two revision rounds; 30 days of post-launch support.
- Mobile app: $3,500 foundation plus $300 per screen (1 to 60 screens). The foundation includes: discovery call and product plan; project setup and navigation shell; test builds on real devices; two revision rounds; 30 days of post-launch support.
- A website with 5 pages and no extra blocks costs $2,450. An app with 8 screens and no extra blocks costs $5,900.
- SEO, AEO & GEO: SEO optimization $50 per page, AEO / GEO optimization $50 per page, Local SEO $250, Keyword & content strategy $400, SEO-safe migration $300.
- Templates: Personal site $2,850, Small business $7,730, SaaS startup $13,980, Mobile MVP $12,990, Enterprise platform $32,605.
- Payment: a 50% deposit to start with the balance invoiced before launch, or the full amount up front.

## Who runs it

- Wissile Sogoyou, a software engineer with over 15 years of experience across enterprise software, small-business projects and personal projects, based in Salt Lake City, Utah. Fluidweb is his freelance studio.
- Customers: individuals, small businesses and startups. Larger and enterprise projects start with a conversation through the contact page.

## Portfolio

- [Meetworkplace](https://meetworkplace.com/): An enterprise social network that matches colleagues by shared interests. A marketing site with a blog and sales contact, plus the employee app with AI matchmaking, push messages and surveys. The same blocks cost $27,790 in the builder today. Case study: case-study-meetworkplace.html
- [Bio Nature Santé](https://bionaturesante.com/): A French-language shop for organic essential oils and skin care in Lomé. Product and wellness service pages, a cart with delivery zones, and orders that finish on WhatsApp. The same blocks cost $8,480 in the builder today. Case study: case-study-bio-nature-sante.html
- [FiredBunny](https://firedbunny.com/): A free personal-finance school you learn by playing: 159 lessons with quizzes, 50 calculators and simulators, a market calendar and a dashboard saved on your device. The same blocks cost $15,460 in the builder today. Case study: case-study-firedbunny.html
- [Alta Perspective](https://altaperspective.com/): A Salt Lake City studio for luxury real estate photography, video, drone and 3D tours. Image-led service pages, pricing, case studies and a booking request form. The same blocks cost $6,150 in the builder today. Case study: case-study-alta-perspective.html
